member.name: T:JustCause.Textures.Core.SearchRootResolver
member.summary: Resolves headers and streams across one or more directory trees (e.g. an extracted game), not just the adjacent folder. Files are indexed by base name (the part before the extension), so a loose .hmddsc/.atx finds its .ddsc wherever it lives under a configured root. Adjacent files always win over indexed ones. Base-name collisions across the tree are first-wins and recorded in . Note: this matches on the readable file name; hash-named extractions need the master namelist to bridge hash to name first (a later step).
